title.original: Janus: a Playground for User-Involved Agentic Permission Management
title.zh: Janus：用户参与式智能体权限管理实验平台
title.en: Janus: a Playground for User-Involved Agentic Permission Management

inclusion_reason.zh: Janus-Core 与 Janus-Harness 提供可插拔权限助手、用户行为模拟和安全/负担测量，是用户参与权限研究的共享试验场。
inclusion_reason.en: Janus-Core and Janus-Harness provide pluggable permission assistants, user-behavior simulation, and security/burden measurement as a shared permission-research testbed.

abstract.zh: Janus 是研究用户参与 Agent 权限管理的可编程试验场，由可插拔权限执行核心和自动评测 Harness 组成。
abstract.en: Janus is a programmable testbed for user-involved agent permissions, combining a modular permission-enforcement core with an automated evaluation harness.

problem.zh: Agent 权限设计常只讨论模型或策略，缺少系统化比较用户在何时介入、看到什么、由 AI 如何辅助及疲劳如何影响安全。
problem.en: Agent permission designs rarely compare when users intervene, what they see, how AI assists them, and how permission fatigue affects security.

approach.zh: 作者以用户参与设计轴构造六种权限助手，在多个场景和不同合成响应者上比较隐私、安全与认知负担。
approach.en: Six permission assistants are instantiated from design axes for user involvement and compared across scenarios and synthetic responders for privacy, security, and cognitive burden.

system_design.zh: Janus-Core 提供 Agent、工具和权限决策的模块接口；Janus-Harness 重放场景、模拟用户回答并记录允许、拒绝、泄露与交互成本。
system_design.en: Janus-Core modularizes agents, tools, and permission decisions; Janus-Harness replays scenarios, simulates responses, and records allowance, denial, leakage, and interaction cost.

key_results.zh: 用户输入能显著增强隐私与安全，AI 辅助可减轻负担，但权限疲劳会改变结果，且没有一种设计适合所有上下文。
key_results.en: User input materially improves privacy and security, AI assistance can reduce burden, fatigue changes outcomes, and no design is optimal across all contexts.

limitations.zh: 评测依赖少量场景和合成响应者，无法替代真实用户的长期适应、误解和风险偏好；用户研究与高风险部署仍待开展。
limitations.en: A small scenario set and synthetic responders cannot replace real users' long-term adaptation, misunderstanding, and risk preferences; user studies and high-risk deployments remain needed.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
